name: ff-news-bot
description: Telegram bot: ForexFactory economic calendar daily digest + real-time alerts
instructions: Python 3.12 project. Two entrypoints: src/run_digest.py (one-shot, run by GitHub Actions cron) and src/run_alerts.py (long-running poller, deployed on Render as a worker).

FF data comes from the unofficial export feed at nfs.faireconomy.media/ff_calendar_thisweek.json — NOT scraped HTML. Rate limit is 2 requests/5min across all export formats, so POLL_INTERVAL_MINUTES must stay >= 5.

Event de-duplication for alerts happens in src/store.py against data/seen_events.json — verify this file's schema matches the real FF feed response before relying on it (the feed's exact field names should be confirmed against a live response).
Telegram sending is a thin wrapper in src/telegram_client.py using the raw Bot API (no polling/webhook needed since the bot only pushes messages).
Config is centralized in src/config.py via .env — copy .env.example to .env for local dev.
